propositions: ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget as a per-plan cost cap override but cannot apply it because run_pass1 calls shed_to_budget which computes the cap internally via plan_budget_cap(ctx) with no injection point.

The existing REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET env var is not a true cap override because it is centrality-scaled (base * (1.0 + ctx.centrality)), and the runner currently journals the request and drops it with a WARNING.

A cap_override parameter must be added along the call chain ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> shed_to_budget, used verbatim without centrality scaling, defaulting to None to preserve current byte-identical behavior.
cap_override=None selects the computed cap, while explicit 0.0 is honourable as 'shed everything sheddable' and must not be treated as falsy/absent.
The plan-review gate YAML does not set usd_budget on finders batch step today, so live gate behavior remains unchanged; the seam builds the mechanism without starting to set a budget in YAML.
